shared_elements: schematic incised linear signs or motifs
justification: The limited overlap is that both surfaces include schematic carved/incised linear markings, including some circular or oval sign-like forms. The main difference is that A is dominated by dense horizontal rows of small repeated inscription-like signs, while B presents a large frontal anthropomorphic or mask-like figure with a few large body/facial motifs rather than a comparable text-like field.
